topic: The Attention Mechanism: How Transformers Read
target_audience: University students with basic computer science knowledge

sections.title: The Problem: Contextual Ambiguity
lecture_lines: Language is ambiguous and context dependent.
Words change meaning based on neighbors.
We need to look at whole sentences simultaneously.
animations: Display 'The animal...' sentence on center screen with color #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/animal.svg]
Highlight the word 'it' and 'animal' with color #FFD700 (Gold).
Draw a connector line between 'it' and 'animal' in #00FFFF (Cyan).

sections.title: The Core Concept: Query, Key, and Value
lecture_lines: The Transformer uses a database analogy.
Query is what you are looking for.
Key is the label of available information.
Value is the actual content found.
Attention weights these values by similarity.
animations: Display three labeled boxes Q, K, and V in #FF6347 (Tomato).
Animate the search query Q moving toward the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/library.svg] of K keys.
Show similarity scores flashing above K, weighted by importance.
Combine the weighted V values to form a final output.
Fade in a final summary label: 'Result = Attention(Q, K, V)' involving data from the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/database.svg].

sections.title: Visualizing the Score: The Softmax Heatmap
lecture_lines: Attention is a matrix of similarity scores.
Dot products turn queries and keys into scores.
Softmax transforms scores into importance probabilities.
High intensity shows strong attention relationships.
Low intensity shows weak attention relationships.
animations: Draw a 5x5 grid of cells with color #333333 (Dark Gray).
Fill grid cells with calculated score values as text.
Apply heatmap coloring, glowing red #FF0000 for high values.
Display Softmax transformation on top, normalizing to 0-1 range.
Pulse the bright red cell ('it'-[Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/animal.svg]) to emphasize focus.

sections.title: Multi-Head Attention: Parallel Perspectives
lecture_lines: Heads attend to different linguistic features.
animations: Display 8 separate, smaller attention grids arranged in a circle, each featuring a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/eye.svg] icon to symbolize focus.
Rotate each grid independently to show unique internal focus.
Merge all grids into a single, comprehensive summary matrix, represented by a central [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg] icon.

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Transformers abandon sequential processing for parallel attention.
This allows scaling to massive models.
Attention is the spotlight of AI power.
animations: Show a static text box: 'Parallel Processing beats Sequential'.
Final fade to black with '#FFFFFF' text: 'Attention is All You Need'.
